include_messages.description: Also list revisions of your messages (default: no; they live in handoff_inbox).

box.description: "in" (default): messages to you; "out": sent by you (also shows answers you have not seen yet).

include_done.description: Also list done and declined messages.

space.description: Only this inbox space (default: every inbox space you are in).

input.description: Status: new, updated (changed after you received it), received, done, declined. Read a message with read(id), then handoff_ack it.

since.description: Optional: next_cursor of an earlier result; then only events after it wake you.

events.description: Optional: inbox (mail to you), answers (your sent mail answered) or both (default).
